brief.scope:
The fixture batch (four fixture apps, `ops/bin/fixture.sh`, the findings lever) had its one fix round (two implement runs) and its security re-audit returned changes again. By D-LADDER-1 the batch gets no second fix round; the unresolved findings are this slice's scope and it runs the whole ladder: tests (Grok) → skeptic → implement (Codex) per S bucket → audits once → one fix round → security re-audit → draft PR.
D-LADDER-1 (register, standing ratified, `ops/conductor/decisions.seed.json`, decided_by owner 2026-09-04): an implement run covers at most one S bucket and an M slice is implemented in two runs the plan names; the security and adversarial audits run once per batch on the merged tree, never per slice, with one fix round and the security re-audit only; the skeptic runs once on the first tests and never on the fixed tests.
Bucket sizes (owner, 2026-09-04): S = 1–3 files, one implement run under 10 minutes; M = two named S buckets (run A, run B), each landed and green alone; L = split.

findings.claim: All four tests exercise only an implement/Codex/write launch. An implementation that scopes the temporary environment and directories to Codex write jobs would pass while Grok and other harness children still use host temporary paths, violating the every-harness-child contract and leaving the original residue escape unguarded.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("ops/devlane/dispatch/tests/test_launch_isolation.py"); s=p.read_text(); b=s[s.index("class CodexWriteJobStaysInsideTheJobDirectory"):]; assert b.count("self._launch_codex_write()") == 4; assert "job=\"implement\", harness=\"codex\", stage=\"code\"" in b; assert "harness=\"grok\"" not in b and "harness=\"claude\"" not in b and "job=\"plan\"" not in b'

findings.claim: The pre-spawn witness and assertions cover scratch/ but never the required <job>/scratch/git/ parent. An implementation omitting scratch/git/ passes all four tests although the contracted index and object destinations are not prepared before spawn.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("/home/scientdb/.local/state/agentscient/dispatch/20260904T133558Z-check-tests-codex-efaded/in/PLAN-fixture-fix2-dispatch-job-scratch.md").read_text(); h=Path("ops/devlane/dispatch/tests/launch_support.py").read_text(); t=Path("ops/devlane/dispatch/tests/test_launch_isolation.py").read_text(); b=t[t.index("class CodexWriteJobStaysInsideTheJobDirectory"):]; assert "<job>/scratch/git/" in p; assert "job_scratch_is_dir" in h and "job_scratch_git_is_dir" not in h; assert "scratch/git" not in b and "job_dir / \"scratch\" / \"git\"" not in b'
